thread:
sam: Heads up: Support flagged a customer who saw provisional token spikes during streaming reconnects. They reported apparent double-billing on tool calls when truncation + quick reconnects happen.
olivia: Any traces or timestamps? did this line up with the recent router roll?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: router v2.1 partial rollout started 2025-02-11T09:40:00Z, paused 09:51:12Z for a config tweak
ben: Quick log excerpt from the customer: ```
[09:42:11] session=org-42 prefix=0x1a attempt=aa1 event=stream_start
[09:42:15] attempt=aa1 event=tool_call tokens=95 (no provisional emitted yet)
[09:42:17] network drop, client reconnect -> new attempt=aa2
[09:42:18] attempt=aa2 event=tool_call tokens=95 provisional=true
[09:42:30] final_ack attempt=aa2 confirmed=true
```
sam: So ledger only saw provisional for aa2 and then a confirmed for aa2. aa1 never made it to ledger because it crashed before the provisional emit path completed. But customers see an interim provisional spike (aa2) and worry.
marta: Our dedupe is keyed by attempt id. With new router behavior we sometimes create fresh attempt ids on reconnects. Proposal: prefer a dedupe key chain of (session_id if present, else client_addr+start_ts_floor) + prefix_hash + resume_offset when available. Fallback to attempt_id only if other signals missing.
ben: session_id is ideal but many older SDKs don't set it. We should also encourage SDK change to always set session_id and resume_seq.
olivia: UX: console should default to showing "confirmed cost" and hide provisional rows unless user toggles them. Additionally show a "provisional timeline" for org admins with explanation: provisional rows represent in-flight attempts and may be reconciled.
billing-bot: billing-bot: Request logged: add ledger tags: provisional=true/false, provisional_reason=(replay|truncation|client_retry|router_retry), original_attempt_id (nullable), resume_offset (nullable). These fields should be included in billing export and CSV.
sam: Telemetry suggestion: router should emit `reconnect_trigger` (client_timeout|network|router_roll), `original_attempt_seen` (bool), and `attempt_link_hint` (session|prefix_hash|none). We can then run queries to tune the grace_window.
marta: Short-term mitigation: router dedupe heuristic: if reconnect happens within 12s and prefix_hash matches and KV cache still holds, consider this a replay and mark replayed attempts provisional_replay. Ledger should record provisional_replay but hold finalization for a short reconcile window (e.g., 45s) unless a final_ack arrives.
ben: Risk: holding too long undercounts real retries. So ledger should mark provisional rows visible but treat them as tentative until confirmed or reconcile window expires. Console wording needs to make this distinction clear.
olivia: Add an ops setting: "auto-reconcile provisional after N minutes" default off. Also an org-level alert when provisional_sum - confirmed_sum > 1000 tokens in 10m.
billing-bot: Filed BILL-1210 to add ledger fields and export changes. INFRA-2607 to prototype provisional_hold semantics.
sam: Long-term: persist attempt mappings in a tiny MV store (TTL 2-5 minutes) so replay correlation survives router restarts. Also add server-side attempt_id reuse when we detect same session+prefix within grace_window.
marta: One more internal API debate: should the router set original_attempt_id on replay events or should the client SDK supply a session_id and let routers be stateless? My vote: both. Make SDKs emit session_id asap; routers should still set original_attempt_id when they can to protect older clients.
ben: Agreed. We'll need a small schema RFC for telemetry and ledger tags. I'll draft it and include console mock for provisional toggle.
olivia: I'll mock the console changes and the hover text for provisional. Keep the default view focused on confirmed cost to reduce customer panic.
sam: Action items: ben -> RFC + ledger change PR, marta -> router dedupe PoC, infra -> INFRA-2607 prototype, olivia -> console mock copy, billing-bot -> BILL-1210. Pairing volunteers? ben + marta for PoC.
marta: pairing acked. :thumbsup:
